case_number: Civil Appeal No. 3904 of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 10447 of 2019)

parties.respondent: The Reliance General Insurance Company Limited & Anr.

summary: Challenge to High Court's quashing of compensation awarded under Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923; issue of jurisdiction and quantum of compensation; claim initially awarded Rs.4,31,671 by Deputy Labour Commissioner but set aside by High Court on ground of lack of jurisdiction in contested matter; Supreme Court held no real contest as employer admitted liability and insurer did not contest further; accepted deceased's income as Rs.6,000/month based on wife's deposition and employer's admission; recalculated compensation at Rs.6,64,110 using multiplier 221.37; awarded interest at 12% p.a. from one month after accident; appeal allowed in part.
legal_provisions_cited: The Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1923, Section 20(1) and (2)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; impugned judgment of Patna High Court set aside; compensation awarded at Rs.6,64,110 with interest at 12% p.a. from one month after the date of accident till date of payment, excluding amount already paid; balance amount to be deposited within six weeks before Deputy Labour Commissioner, Gaya.
